title: carpesium nepalense var. lanatum
intro: Carpesium nepalense var. lanatum, commonly known as the Nepal carps, is a type of flowering plant in the daisy family Asteraceae. This plant has been traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties and is valued for its health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal properties. The therapeutic actions of Carpesium nepalense var. lanatum include its ability to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and treat various skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant are primarily sesquiterpenes and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
